rationale: VERSION 2.2.0 -> 3.0.0: replaced ten dead, clamped, alias, and degenerate controls with exact scene_profile and layout_variant axes.; Rebuilt defaults around all three complete public canvas/count/singleton/zero-role profiles with a 40% exact public-morphology prior and three lawful reflection variants.; Added the entirely missing no-singleton branch and made zero the fixed answer-bearing big role in the held-out profile.; Replaced the toothless self_check with strict ARC parsing, returned-grid count and role extraction, exact morphology recognition, and observable exact axes.; Added a broad input-pure Python rule mirror, difficulty-weighted profile selection, focused mutation/source tests, two disjoint 60,000-draw censuses, 60 recombinations, 500 live-Racket cases, and trainer-facing visual evidence.
summary: Use the most frequent nonzero color as background. Sort every remaining color by cell count; the largest repeated count becomes a solid upper-right square, the next repeated count becomes a solid lower-left square, and the first singleton color—when one exists—is placed at the bottom-left corner. Square side lengths are the integer roots of their counts. A singleton introduces the demonstrated two-column left offset; without one, the small square starts at column zero.
